title: Chicken Chilaquiles with Guajillo Tomato Sauce
changes_from_base: Oven-baked tortilla chips instead of fried, a blended red sauce of toasted guajillo chillies, tinned tomatoes, poblano and jalapeño, and chicken breasts poached in the sauce, shredded and stirred back in; served without fried eggs.
summary: Crispy baked tortilla chips tossed with shredded chicken in a deep guajillo chilli sauce, topped with cheese, avocado and fresh coriander.
equipment: large casserole (Dutch oven) with a lid

ingredients.item: gluten-free corn tortillas (15 cm), each cut into 8 wedges
fine sea salt or table salt
dried guajillo chillies, stemmed and seeded
tinned whole peeled tomatoes with their juice
poblano chilli, stemmed, seeded and chopped
sprigs fresh coriander, plus 2 tbsp chopped
fine sea salt or table salt
chicken stock (check stock label for celery)
ripe avocado, cut in 1 cm chunks

steps.title: Toast Chillies
steps.text: Preheat the oven to 220 °C (200 °C fan) with shelves in the upper and lower middle positions; toast 5 dried guajillo chillies (stemmed and seeded) in a large dry casserole over medium heat about 5 minutes until fragrant and slightly darker, then grind them fine in a blender for 60-90 seconds.

steps.title: Blend Sauce
steps.text: Add 800 g tinned whole peeled tomatoes with juice, 105 g of the chopped onion (reserved from the total 140 g), 1 chopped poblano chilli, 1 chopped jalapeño, 8 coriander sprigs, 3 chopped garlic cloves and ¾ tsp fine salt to the blender and blend until very smooth.

steps.title: Chips
steps.text: Divide 16 corn tortillas (cut into 8 wedges each) between 2 large rimmed baking trays, drizzle each with 2 tbsp olive oil and ¼ tsp fine salt, toss and bake 15-20 minutes until golden and crisp, stirring and swapping the trays halfway through.

steps.title: Chicken
steps.text: Pour the sauce into the casserole, stir in 360 ml chicken stock and bring to the boil over medium-high; add 680 g boneless, skinless chicken breasts, lower the heat and simmer uncovered 15-20 minutes, turning once, until the thickest part reaches 74 °C.

steps.title: Finish Sauce
steps.text: Remove the chicken to a plate and simmer the sauce 5 minutes more over medium until thick (about 1000 ml); shred the chicken with 2 forks, return it to the sauce and warm 2 minutes.

steps.title: Assemble
steps.text: Add the crisp tortilla chips, toss until coated, take off the heat, season to taste, cover and rest 2-5 minutes (longer for softer chips); top with 115 g crumbled queso fresco, chunks of 1 ripe avocado, 2 thinly sliced radishes, the remaining chopped onion and 2 tbsp chopped coriander, then serve with 120 ml soured cream and lime wedges.

tips: Grind the toasted chillies finely to ensure a smooth sauce with no bitter pieces
Check the chicken reaches 74 °C in the thickest part for food safety
Toss the chips with the sauce just before serving and rest for a few minutes so they absorb flavour without becoming too soggy
storage: Serve hot. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
